companyName: Fort St. James Green Energy Project

sources.label: BioNorth FY2026 Report on Forced Labour and Child Labour
sources.note: The current report directly identifies BioNorth Holdings Limited Partnership as a joint venture under a limited partnership agreement among Nak'azdli Development Corporation, 1323394 B.C. Unlimited Liability Company, Arrow Northern Services Inc. and BioNorth Services Ltd. It says the board approved the report and is attested by the CEO of BioNorth Services Ltd. on 2026-04-14. It does not allocate percentages, identify beneficial owners or parents, map either non-Arrow/non-Nak'azdli entity to Nexus PMG, or explain the relationship between Holdings LP and Energy LP.

sources.label: Nak'azdli Whut'en FY2024 Audited Financial Statements
sources.note: The audited statements for the year ended 2024-03-31 identify Nak'azdli Development Corporation as 100% owned and list BioNorth Holdings Limited Partnership as a 40%-owned government business partnership. They do not provide the other partners' unit schedule, establish a direct Energy-LP interest or supply a cutoff-current 2026 cap table.

sources.label: Arrow FY2024 Report on Forced Labour and Child Labour

visualVerification.finding: Arrow Transportation Systems Inc. is identified as the Arrow Group parent, and BioNorth Energy Limited Partnership is listed as a 40% joint venture and a 40 MW biomass power plant in Fort St. James.

sources.note: The report supports Arrow's 40% FY2024 economic disclosure at Energy LP. It does not by itself identify Arrow Northern Services Inc. as the holder of that 40%, bridge Energy LP to Holdings LP or prove the cutoff-current 2026 stake.

sources.label: 2026 British Columbia Gazette Environmental Protection Notice
sources.note: The direct 2026-03-12 Gazette notice identifies BioNorth Energy Limited Partnership, by its general partner BioNorth Services Ltd., as the environmental-permit applicant for bottom ash from BioNorth's Fort St. James biomass plant. It resolves the GP and operating-role boundary but supplies no partnership ownership schedule.

sources.label: 1323394 B.C. Unlimited Liability Company Corporate Registry Notice
sources.note: The direct corporate-registry notice records company number 1323394 as 1323394 B.C. Unlimited Liability Company incorporated on 2021-09-08. The notice contains no parent, controller, director, beneficial-owner, Nexus PMG affiliate or BioNorth partnership-interest disclosure.

sources.label: BioNorth Services Ltd. Corporate Registry Notice
sources.note: The direct corporate-registry notice records company number 1312308 changing its name from BioNorth Energy Ltd. to BioNorth Services Ltd. on 2021-09-02. The notice identifies no parent, controller, director, beneficial owner or economic partnership interest.

sources.label: BioNorth 2021 Acquisition Closing Release
sources.note: The direct 2021-12-02 release states that BioNorth Energy Limited Partnership completed its acquisition of the 40 MW project and describes the buyer-side joint venture as Arrow Group, Nak'azdli Development Corporation and Nexus PMG. It supplies no percentages, legal holder schedule, exact seller entities or mapping from the named sponsors to the four Holdings-LP parties.

sources.label: 2013 Fort St. James Project Financing Release
sources.note: The direct 2013 release names Fengate Capital Management Ltd. and Dalkia Canada Inc. as developers and equity investors in the then Fort St. James Green Energy Limited Partnership structure and describes project debt financing. It names no infrastructure fund, investor percentages or post-2021 continuing ownership.

sourceSetAssessment.primaryLabel: BioNorth FY2026 Report on Forced Labour and Child Labour
sourceSetAssessment.reason: It is the freshest direct company report and uniquely identifies all four current parties to the Holdings-LP joint venture, while exposing rather than filling the missing percentages and affiliate mappings.
sourceSetAssessment.gap: No direct partnership schedule, registry profile, legal filing or sponsor disclosure identifies the current 100% Energy-LP/Holdings-LP economic chain, maps 1323394 B.C. Unlimited Liability Company or BioNorth Services Ltd. to Nexus PMG, or legally allocates the apparent residual 20 percentage points.

conclusion: Fresh direct evidence confirms the single 40 MW asset, the 2021 acquisition close, the four current parties named for BioNorth Holdings Limited Partnership, Nak'azdli's FY2024 40% interest at Holdings LP, Arrow's FY2024 40% joint-venture disclosure at Energy LP, BioNorth Services Ltd. as Energy LP's general partner, and the historic Fengate/Dalkia roles. The two 40% disclosures sit at different unbridged levels, and no direct source supplies the current 100% unit schedule or maps the unresolved parties to Nexus PMG. Keep the task deferred and do not infer Nexus at 20%, a complete cap table, fund ownership or current percentages from subtraction or sponsor naming.
